title: WorkflowSchema
description:
Workflow schema supporting job execution with functions and tools.
Runtime expressions are supported in fields marked in descriptions: - jq syntax: ${.key.subkey} for data access, ${$task.input} for context - liquid syntax: $${..} for templates
Available context variables: - Task input data: direct key access via ${.key} (only within current task context) - Task output data: direct key access via ${.key} (only within current task context) - Context vars: set by task.export, setTask (access via $variable_name for jq, {{ variable_name }} for liquid) - Workflow: access via $workflow (e.g., $workflow.input.key, $workflow.id, $workflow.definition, $workflow.context_variables) - Task: access via $task (e.g., $task.definition, $task.input, $task.raw_output, $task.output, $task.flow_directive)

timeout.description: Workflow-level timeout configuration. Applied to the implicit root task that wraps all tasks declared under `do`. Overrides the `WORKFLOW_TASK_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC` environment variable (default 3600s) and allows specifying durations longer than 1 hour.

authentications.description: Named authentication policy definitions referenced via authentication.use.

secrets.description: Declared secret names. Values are supplied at runtime via the WORKFLOW_SECRET_<UPPER_SNAKE_NAME> environment variable.

secretBasedAuthenticationPolicy.title: SecretBasedAuthenticationPolicy
secretBasedAuthenticationPolicy.description: Reference to a declared secret (under use.secrets), resolved from the WORKFLOW_SECRET_<UPPER_SNAKE_NAME> environment variable.

authenticationPolicy.title: AuthenticationPolicy
authenticationPolicy.description: Inline authentication policy. Property values may be literals or runtime expressions, or the scheme may reference a declared secret via { use: <name> }.

then.description: Flow control directive executed after task completion.

checkpoint.title: Checkpoint
checkpoint.description: Save workflow state after this task for checkpoint/restart.

at.title: ForAt

while.title: While

onError.title: ForOnError

with.title: CallTaskWith
with.description: Call input. HTTP or gRPC parameters.

callHttp.title: CallHttp
callHttp.description: HTTP call parameters supported by the jobworkerp adapter.

endpoint.title: HttpEndpoint
endpoint.description: Literal endpoint URI or endpoint object.

authentication.title: HttpEndpointAuthentication
authentication.description: Endpoint authentication. Inline bearer/basic policy, or a reference to a named policy declared under use.authentications.

use.title: AuthenticationPolicyUse
use.description: Name of a policy declared under use.authentications.

headers.title: HttpHeaders
headers.description: Header map. Values are converted to strings by the executor.

query.title: HttpQuery
query.description: Query parameter map. Values are converted to strings by the executor.

body.title: HttpBody
body.description: Request body. Non-string values are serialized as JSON.

callGrpc.description: gRPC unary call parameters supported by the jobworkerp adapter. The arguments map is sent as a JSON body resolved via server reflection.

proto.description: Official proto resource reference. Accepted for validation but not executed by the jobworkerp adapter (reflection is used instead); rejected at execution time.

name.title: GrpcServiceName

host.title: GrpcServiceHost
host.description: Hostname or IP of the gRPC server.

authentication.title: GrpcServiceAuthentication
authentication.description: Service authentication. Inline bearer policy, or a reference to a named policy declared under use.authentications. Only bearer is supported; basic is rejected at execution time.

use.title: AuthenticationPolicyUse
use.description: Name of a policy declared under use.authentications.

method.title: GrpcMethod
method.description: Name of the gRPC method to invoke on the service.

arguments.title: GrpcArguments
arguments.description: Name/value mapping of the call arguments. Serialized to a JSON request body and converted to protobuf by the runner via reflection.

runTask.title: RunTask
runTask.description: Execute external processes, commands, or workflows.

useStreaming.title: UseStreamingExecution
useStreaming.description:
Whether to use streaming execution mode.
When true:
- Job is executed with streaming enabled
- Intermediate results are broadcast via JobResultService/ListenStream
- Final result is collected using collect_stream and stored in raw_output
Useful for LLM runners or other long-running processes where progress monitoring is needed.

await.title: AwaitProcessCompletion
await.description: Wait for process completion before continuing.

runner.title: RunJobRunner
runner.description: Executes a job using a specified runner.

name.title: RunnerName
name.description: The name of the runner (runtime environment) that executes the job (e.g., COMMAND, HTTP, GRPC, PYTHON_COMMAND, LLM_CHAT, MCP server names, plugin names, etc.)

using.title: Using
using.description:
Selects which implementation to use for runners with multiple tools.

- **Required**: For runners with multiple tools (e.g., fetch server with "fetch" and "fetch_html")
- **Optional**: For single-tool runners (auto-selected)

Examples:
- MCP fetch server: using: "fetch_html"
- MCP time server (single tool): can be omitted
- COMMAND runner: not needed

settings.title: InitializeSettings
settings.description: The initialization settings, if any. Runtime expressions can be used to transform each value (not keys, no mixed plain text).

arguments.title: JobArguments
arguments.description: A key/value mapping of arguments to use when running the runner as job. Runtime expressions are supported for value transformation.

workerOptions.title: WorkerOptions
workerOptions.description: The options to use when running the worker.

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: The channel to use when running the worker (controls execution concurrency).

queueType.title: QueueType
queueType.description: Defines how jobs are queued and persisted. Values: NORMAL (default, in-memory only), WITH_BACKUP (in-memory with database backup), DB_ONLY (database only).

responseType.title: ResponseType
responseType.description: Defines how job results should be returned to the client. Values: NO_RESULT (async, no wait), DIRECT (default, synchronous with result).

storeSuccess.title: StoreSuccessResult
storeSuccess.description: Whether to store successful results in the database.

storeFailure.title: StoreFailureResult
storeFailure.description: Whether to store failure results in the database.

useStatic.title: UseStaticWorker
useStatic.description: Whether to use a static worker (persisted in database with pooled initialization).

retry.title: RetryPolicyDefinition
retry.description: The retry policy to use, if any, when catching errors.

broadcastResults.title: BroadcastResultsToListener
broadcastResults.description: Whether to broadcast results to listeners.

worker.title: RunJobWorker

name.title: WorkerName

runScript.title: RunScript
runScript.description:
Execute inline or external scripts. This is close to Open Workflow
v1.0.0 run.script. await is supported (await: false runs fire-and-forget),
and return shapes the process result (stdout/stderr/code/all/none, default
stdout). Unlike run.shell / run.container, run.script has no
treatNonzeroAsError / successExitCodes option: a non-zero exit always
fails the task before return is applied, so return: code / all only
observe a successful exit (0).

await.description: Wait for process completion before continuing.

script.title: ScriptConfiguration
script.description: Script execution configuration. unevaluatedProperties is true to allow language-specific properties (e.g., virtualenv for Python, modulePaths for JavaScript).

language.title: ScriptLanguage
language.description: Script language identifier (e.g., 'python', 'javascript'). Validated at runtime.

arguments.title: ScriptArguments
arguments.description: Arguments passed to the script. Runtime expressions are supported for value transformation. Each key becomes a variable in the script.

set.title: SetTaskConfiguration

switchTask.description: Conditional branching based on runtime conditions.

tryTask.title: TryTask

exceptWhen.title: CatchExceptWhen

waitTask.title: WaitTask

flowDirective.title: FlowDirective
flowDirective.description: Control flow directive for workflow execution path. Either a reserved keyword or a runtime expression / target task name. Use anyOf (per Open Workflow v1.0.0 spec) instead of oneOf because reserved keywords also satisfy the unconstrained string branch.

oneOf.title: DurationInline

errorFilter.title: ErrorFilter

output.title: Output

processResult.title: ProcessResult
